name: OriginGate
headline: A wallet that checks `tx.origin == owner`, so a phished owner's call drains it

flaws.note: withdraw() authorizes with tx.origin; an attacker contract called by the owner passes the check and can send the balance anywhere

expected_proof.notes: Owner funds the wallet with 10 ETH, then is tricked into calling a malicious contract that calls withdraw(attacker, balance) — tx.origin is still the owner.
